{{Quote|If you want to train like a soldier, then you might as well serve the right side.|Judder Page's father sends his son to the Imperial Academy|<ref name="httesb 30" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''senator''' served in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] as a representative of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. Influential and corrupt, he pampered his son, [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]], who in turn despised him and used his wealth to train in combat. The [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] eventually sent his son to the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], hoping that Page's combat skills could serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Many doors were opened for Page due to the Senator's influence, but the young man ultimately defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="httesb 30" /> represented his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' {{C|under "Lieutenant Page"}}</ref> He was a prominent yet corrupt [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who gave his son, [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]], a pampered upbringing. Page despised his [[Parent/Legends|father]], whom he wished could be more like the legendary [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Inspired by tales of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Page used his father's wealth to train himself in a variety of combat and defense techniques. The Senator indulged his son's fancy, supposing that the boy's idealism was merely a phase.<ref name="httesb 30" />

[[File:JudderPage-SWR.png|thumb|right|200px|Judder Page, the Senator's son]]
Over the subsequent [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Page grew into a young man with strong moral standards. The Senator sent him to the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], reasoning that if his son were to train to be a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], his skills would best be put to use in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As the son of a prominent senator from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], Page found that vast avenues of study were open to him. Shortly after graduating with honors, Page defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a militant faction that opposed the Empire in the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="httesb 30" /> Although the Imperial Senate was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolved]] by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Page was still considered the scion of an influential family [[29 ABY/Legends|thirty years later]].<ref name="The Unifying Force Chapter 1">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The Senator was a corrupt individual and was hated by his son, Judder Page, who believed that his father had sold out<ref name="httesb 30" /> and that he possessed moral deficiencies.<ref name="Second Edition">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' {{C|under "Lieutenant Page"}}</ref> The Senator gave Page a pampered childhood and allowed his son to use his wealth to train in combat techniques,<ref name="httesb 30" /> but he later forced Page to attend the Imperial Academy against the young man's wishes.<ref name="SWE" /> The Senator's influence opened many doors for Page at the academy.<ref name="httesb 30" />

==Behind the scenes==
Judder Page's father was first mentioned in [[1991]]'s ''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]'', a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Bill Slavicsek]].<ref name="httesb 30" /> Page's father has been stated to be the Imperial Senator from Corulag<ref name="SWE" /> for years,<ref name="httesb 30" /> but [[2003]]'s ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'' assigns that position to the character of [[Zafiel Snopps]] "in the [[Rise of the Empire era]] and most of the [[Rebellion era]],"<ref name="CCW 79">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> a [[Time/Legends|time]] period that encompasses the Imperial Senate's entire existence.<ref name="NEC" /> This information was never reconciled in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity.
